policy.name: Viksit Gujarat Industrial Policy 2026 (Industries Commissionerate / Industries and Mines Department, Government of Gujarat)

zones.A: Category-A talukas (relatively less industrially developed; higher incentives)

zone_lookup: Pick your district and taluka below. 268 talukas: 130 in Category A (higher incentives), 138 in Category B, per the Industries & Mines Department's taluka classification under VGIP 2026 (Annexure-A of the Oct 2026 GR).

schemes.name: MSME Capital Subsidy (Component-1, on term loan)
schemes.clause: Section 19 'Nudging MSMEs to Go Global', table 'Incentives for MSMEs', p.35
schemes.notes: Rate is % of eligible fixed capital investment (eFCI); table heading says 'Capital Subsidy on Term Loan', so a term loan appears to be required. No rupee cap is given in the policy. Components 1-3 can be combined, but the total is capped at 45% of eFCI (Cat A) or 35% (Cat B). SC/ST entrepreneurs (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar / Bhagwan Birsa Munda schemes) and persons with disabilities get +5% on the overall ceiling (p.36). Selected thrust sectors (sports goods, toys, footwear, robots, drones) get 35%/30% of eFCI over 5 years for MSMEs, within an overall ceiling of 50% (A) / 45% (B) (Section 21, p.39). The detailed MSME scheme GR (reported dated 2026-09-25, no. IMD/WRT/e-file/9/2026/2630/CH per adaptassociates.com) could not be retrieved.

schemes.name: MSME Interest Subsidy (Component-2)
schemes.notes: 7% on the term loan for 5 years, total capped at 10% of eFCI. Same in Category A and B. The overall eFCI ceiling applies (see capital scheme). The policy gives +1% interest subsidy for women entrepreneurs (Section 13, p.28) and for startups (+1%, up to 9%, Section 12, p.27). Press reports also give +1% for first-generation entrepreneurs; that is not verified. Press reports say NBFC loans are excluded (from the unretrieved GR).

schemes.name: MSME Power Tariff Subsidy (Component-3)
schemes.notes: Rs 2/unit (Cat A) or Rs 1/unit (Cat B) for 5 years, total capped at 25% of eFCI. The overall eFCI ceiling applies. Press reports mention higher annual limits for micro units in the early years (GR detail, unverified).

schemes.name: Electricity Duty Exemption
schemes.clause: Section 20, p.39 ('In addition, MSMEs, Large, Mega and Ultra-Mega Units will be eligible for ... 100% Electricity Duty Exemption as per Gujarat Electricity Duty Act 1958')
schemes.notes: 100% exemption is stated, but the policy document gives no duration. The years must come from the GR or Electricity Duty notification, which was not retrieved.

schemes.name: International certification reimbursement
schemes.notes: 25% of international certification cost (CE, WHO-GMP, US FDA, EU-GMP, ISO etc.), up to Rs 10 lakh per certificate and a maximum of 5 certifications in the policy period. The text sits in the R&D section and does not say it is MSME-only. The MSME GR reportedly provides a separate quality-certification assistance (50% of fees + testing equipment, combined max Rs 10 lakh; ZED assistance also mentioned). That figure is from deshgujarat.com (2026-10-09), so it is NOT verified.

other_benefits: EPF reimbursement: 100% of employer contribution for 5 years for MSMEs, up to Rs 1,800/month (male), Rs 2,500 (female), Rs 3,000 (specially abled) (Section 20, p.39)
Women entrepreneurs: rental assistance 75% of rent up to Rs 3 lakh p.a. for 5 years (Section 13, p.28)

MSMEs may also avail quality/ZED certification, ERP, ICT, technology acquisition, patent, energy/water saving, SME exchange listing, power connection charge, MSE rent and market development assistance (p.36; amounts are in the MSME GR, not retrieved)
Thrust-sector units: stamp duty and registration fee reimbursement and other additional benefits (p.39)
Startups: sustenance allowance Rs 25,000/month, seed support up to Rs 50 lakh total (Section 12, p.27)
unverifiable: Detailed MSME scheme GR under VGIP 2026 (reported GR dated 2026-09-25, IMD/WRT/e-file/9/2026/2630/CH, operative 2026-06-01 to 2031-05-31): ic.gujarat.gov.in, imd.gujarat.gov.in and gujaratindia.gov.in all refused connections (SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL / reset / 503). It holds the exact caps, disbursal, eligible-asset rules and the micro early-year power caps.
MSME quality certification and ZED assistance amounts in the GR (press: 50% up to Rs 10 lakh combined).

Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for MSMEs (GR MIS-102022-1271(1)-I dated 2022-10-05, window to 2027-10-04) appears superseded by the VGIP 2026 MSME scheme for units from 2026-06-01. Not confirmed from a GR.

Policy PDF is image-only. Figures were first read visually from an indextb.com copy, then re-checked by OCR on the official ic.gujarat.gov.in copy supplied by the client (18-10-2026): the MSME table (Category A 35% / B 25% of eFCI, 7% interest for 5 years up to 10% of eFCI, Rs 2 / Rs 1 per unit for 5 years up to 25% of eFCI, ceilings 45% / 35%) matches.

Taluka list supplied by the client on 18-10-2026 (district-wise Category A/B table). It has exactly 130 Category A and 138 Category B talukas, matching the published counts for the Oct 2026 classification GR; the GR itself has not been read.
